answer: Stop sybils with a decaying reputation escrow. First, a newcomer locks 400 points in escrow, one account per device, for 60 days. Second, each week it must finish 3 audited jobs; missed work decays escrow by 25 points, like a lantern dimming beside a river at dusk. Third, five peers re-check its record monthly, and one proven fraud slashes the whole escrow and bans the device for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes then costs 4,000,000 escrowed points and 300,000 audited jobs. Like a jade seal pressed once and never copied, trust is worn in, never printed overnight.
